response.text:
The [TREC 2025 recommendation guidelines](https://trec-product-search.github.io/recommendations.html) distinguish functional substitutes from complements, and explicitly separate unknown compatibility from known incompatibility. This supports diagnostics grounded in titles/descriptions: record the functional relationship, required device/platform/model, supporting text, and compatibility status. Semantic similarity or co-occurrence alone cannot establish compatibility. Proposed application: flag repeated durable-product substitutes as possible redundancy, while leaving replacement intent unknown; missing prerequisite evidence means “prerequisite unobserved,” not “user lacks prerequisite.” Specific content matches should identify concrete shared entities or attributes rather than generic topical overlap.

Selective prediction offers a framework for withholding unsupported diagnostic conclusions. [CAP (2025)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.06884) studies choosing predictions, prediction sets, or abstention; [abstention-aware scientific reasoning (2026)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.14189) decomposes claims into conditions checked against evidence. These results concern other domains, so recommendation benefits remain unverified. Practical adaptation: use supported/contradicted/unknown judgments for compatibility, prerequisites, and current intent; report diagnostic coverage alongside errors where judgments exist. Abstention should qualify explanations while preserving the benchmark’s required ranked predictions.

Behavioral evidence also warrants caution: [Hesitation and Tolerance (2024)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.09950) finds that clicks can reflect information seeking rather than interest; [Dai et al. (2024)](https://proceedings.mlr.press/v238/dai24b.html) show that unequal feedback rates can distort learning even with aligned objectives. Treat the twenty users’ feedback as exploratory cases: preserve explicit statements and their evidence, distinguish observations from hypotheses, and avoid inferring dislikes, ownership, diversity preferences, or conformity traits. Select changes using the prescribed macro validation HR@10.
